title: Interpretability-by-Design with Accurate Locally Additive Models and Conditional Feature Effects
abstract: arXiv:2602.16503v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generalized additive models (GAMs) offer high interpretability through independent univariate feature effects but underfit when interactions are present in data. GA$^2$Ms add selected pairwise interactions which improves accuracy, but sacrifices interpretability. We propose Conditionally Additive Local Models (CALMs), a new model class that narrows this trade-off: it stays close to GAMs in interpretability and close to GA$^2$Ms in accuracy. CALMs allow multiple univariate shape functions per feature, each active in different regions of the input space. These regions are defined independently for each feature as simple logical conditions (thresholds) on the features it interacts with. As a result, effects remain locally additive while varying across subregions to capture interactions. translated_title: 基于设计的可解释性：精确的局部可加模型与条件特征效应
translated_abstract: 广义可加模型（GAMs）通过独立的单变量特征效应提供了高度的可解释性，但当数据中存在交互作用时会出现欠拟合。GA²Ms通过加入选定的成对交互项提高了准确性，但牺牲了可解释性。我们提出了条件可加局部模型（Conditionally Additive Local Models, CALMs），这是一种新的模型类别，能够缩小这种权衡：它在可解释性上接近GAMs，在准确性上接近GA²Ms。CALMs允许每个特征拥有多个单变量形状函数，每个形状函数在输入空间的不同区域中起作用。这些区域针对每个特征独立定义，由其交互特征上的简单逻辑条件（阈值）确定。因此，效应在局部保持可加性，同时在子区域之间变化以捕捉交互作用。我们进一步提出了一种有原则的基于蒸馏的训练流程，该流程能够识别交互作用有限的同质区域并拟合可解释的模型。
tldr: 提出条件可加局部模型（CALMs），通过为每个特征在不同输入区域内定义条件化的单变量效应，在保持接近GAMs可解释性的同时达到接近GA²Ms的准确性，并辅以基于蒸馏的训练流程来识别交互有限的同质区域。
en_tdlr: Proposes Conditionally Additive Local Models (CALMs), which define conditional univariate feature effects across different input regions to achieve accuracy close to GA²Ms while retaining interpretability close to GAMs, supported by a principled distillation-based training pipeline.
